objective: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.

description: How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me.  His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.
What's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

Arugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge.  One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them.  Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
progress: Before I know what we are dealing with here, <class>, I need to study the spell known as Remedy of Arugal. Bring it to me now or I shall be forced to find myself a worthy servant.
completion: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, <class>. If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.
